{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend trousers, straight-leg cut, mid-thigh to ankle length, charcoal gray, heavy woven fabric.
Oversized silk blouse, relaxed boxy fit with drop shoulders and a high neckline, cream white, fluid woven fabric.
Structured tweed blazer, single-breasted with notch lapels and patch pockets, dark forest green, textured woven fabric.
Chunky knit turtleneck sweater, ribbed hem and cuffs with a loose drape, soft beige, fine-gauge wool fabric.
Leather ankle boots, pointed toe with a moderate block heel, chestnut brown, smooth leather.
A sleek structured tote bag, minimalist design with minimal hardware, matte black, coated canvas fabric.
This outfit works because the tailored trousers and structured blazer provide the necessary professional polish required for a business office environment while maintaining comfort throughout a long workday. The oversized silk blouse offers a modern, relaxed silhouette that balances the sharpness of the outer layers without violating any stated refusals or style preferences. Finished with neutral tones and earthy accents, the ensemble seamlessly transitions through autumn daylight hours while adhering strictly to the neat business dress code."}
